title: white fluffy thing
text:
introducing the white fluffy thing
the white fluffy thing is a super hero kitty! he saves the day with his side kick sir fish alots and evil dad is the villan its because he takes white fluffy thing to the vet. dun dun dunnnn! White fluffy thing’s real name is Ward and he has lots of comics and books about his heroic deeds.


back story
Before the White fluffy thing was a hero he was a small cat named Ward he was a very strange cat he drooled alot and loved to stick his head in the fridge he was adopted at Lollypop farm when he was 8 weeks old. He was loved very much he was very special and still is, now he is almost 19 years old and has had many adventures and still has more to come.
